name: Komachi Street

en.name: Komachi Street
en.description: Kamakura's liveliest shopping street, running from Kamakura Station toward Tsurugaoka Hachimangu. It is lined with souvenir shops, cafes and snack stalls selling local specialties, and is busy throughout the day.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Paid public parking options available nearby.

ja.name: 小町通り
ja.description: 鎌倉駅から鶴岡八幡宮方面へ延びる商店街。土産物店やカフェ、名物スイーツの店が軒を連ね、終日にぎわう。
ja.reservation: 事前予約不要。現地にてチケットをご購入いただくか、自由にご見学いただけます。
ja.parking: 周辺の有料駐車場または公共駐車場をご利用いただけます。
